mapper.select: select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, ea.Ea_Code as eaCode, con.Con_Name as conName, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Me_Use_Apply mn left join Me_Enter_Apply ea on ea.Ea_Id=mn.Ea_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Ua_Id where mn.Ua_Id=#{uaId}
